Sasank Kumar

Senior Data Scientist

Address: E-mail:

Sri Venkateshwara Paradise, Taverkere, Bengaluru 560037 kumarsasank3@gmail.com

Mobile:	+91 9804351373

LinkedIn:	https://www.linkedin.com/in/sasank- kumar-a62a86a9

OVERVIEW

AI Alchemist & GenAI Architect with 6+ years of experience building enterprise-grade AI/ML and GenAI solutions that turn raw data into business intelligence and measurable outcomes.

Architected SaaS-scale LLM ecosystems: designed and deployed scalable, cloud-native GenAI platforms integrating RAG, LangChain, and Azure OpenAI.

Leader & mentor: guided cross-functional teams, streamlined end-to-end ML/AI pipelines, and coached professionals on GenAI adoption.

Industry presence: speaker and contributor at global tech summits, simplifying complex AI concepts into actionable strategies for enterprises.

Passionate about bridging cutting-edge AI innovation with tangible business impact, ensuring every solution delivers scalability, security, and ROI.

Delivered impact at scale: built conversational agents that enhanced customer engagement and developed recommendation engines that powered significant business growth.

TECHNICAL SKILL SET

Generative AI:

RAG, LangChain, Chatbot, VectorDB, LLM, Embedding, Prompt Engineering, Azure OpenAI.

Machine Learning:

Linear Regression, Logistic Regression, Decision Tree, Random Forest.

NLP & Deep Learning:

TF-IDF, Word2Vec, RNN, LSTM, Transformer.

Languages & Frameworks:

Python, Scikit-Learn, NLTK, Tensorflow, Pandas, Numpy, Matplotlib, Seaborn, FastAPI, LangChain.

Azure Cloud AI Skills:

Blob Storage, KeyVault, OpenAI, AI Search (Index, Skillset, Indexer), Function App (Blob & https trigger), Web Service, API Gateway, Azure ML Service.

Others:

TMUX, JIRA, WinSCP, FileZilla, Graph API, MSAL, Avaya, Twilio 360, MobaXterm, Intel OpenVINO, Amazon transcribe, whisper, Git, Bitbucket.

AI Products Worked On:

BAP.ai (Competitor to Yellow.ai, Kore.ai, Cognigy.ai)

CERTIFICATIONS

Databricks GenAI Fundamentals

Docker Essentials – Pluralsight

Google Cloud GenAI Foundations

Python for Everybody – Coursera

Master’s Program in Data Science – Intellipaat



EDUCATION

Bachelor of Technology in Electronics and Communication, B.P. Poddar Institute of Management and Technology, Kolkata, 2018

12th from Chandrasheel Vidhyapeeth, Muzaffarpur, 2014

10th from DAV public school, Muzaffarpur, 2012

AWARDS

Innovation Award – BGSW: For deploying GenAI Bot impacting Product Engineering

Top Speaker Award – BGSW: Hackers Garage Diaries

Runner-up – BGSW: Bosch Inter-Unit Sports Meet

Department Head Recognition – BGSW: Outstanding client feedback across quarters

PROFESSIONAL EXPERIENCE

1. Product: BAP.ai

Led the design and implementation of BAP.ai, a SaaS AI platform delivering multichannel virtual agents integrated with GPT-4o, o3-mini.

Developed an automated pipeline for IT support ticket analysis to classify SLA breach reasons and generate human-readable breach explanations using a reasoning-based model.

Designed to handle cost-associated tickets, the system identifies whether a ticket breached its resolution time.

For breached tickets, it intelligently extracts the root cause (breach reason) and provides detailed, contextual explanations to aid in resolution and process improvement.

2. Built RAG-powered platform for oldest operating chemical & pharma company using LangChain and OpenAI

Developed an interactive Q&A chatbot leveraging Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) to interpret queries from the Merck Manual.

Designed and implemented LangChain-based architecture integrating OpenAI’s GPT-3.5, Faiss vector store, and custom prompt chains for accurate medical information retrieval.

Enabled similarity-based retrieval of domain-specific biomedical knowledge using Faiss and chunked embeddings of processed documents.

Built an intuitive Streamlit UI for researchers and clinicians to query the Merck Manual in natural language and receive evidence-backed insights.

3. Chat Summarization Model for Customer Support

Designed and implemented a chat summarization solution to assist support agents in quickly understanding customer issues without manually reviewing lengthy chat histories.

Leveraged Azure OpenAI services with advanced prompt engineering to generate concise, context- aware summaries of multi-turn conversations.

Optimized the model to ensure summaries captured critical details (customer intent, key issues, and prior resolutions), reducing average agent handling time and improving ticket resolution accuracy.

Integrated the model within the support ticketing workflow, enhancing agent productivity and improving customer experience.



1. Internal Project

Built automated NLP pipeline for TTUS email classification, processing 200K+ emails monthly with 87% accuracy, enabling 2K/day ticket creation.

Implemented CI/CD pipelines using Azure DevOps and Intel OpenVINO for production ML deployments, reducing deployment time by 50%.

Contributed to AI CoE initiatives on IoT anomaly detection and chatbot frameworks.

Mentored junior engineers.

2. Client: Sennheiser

Device Simulator simulates Sennheiser transmitters, receivers and microphones used in live concerts and events as well as in conferences and presentation rooms. The purpose of Device Simulator is to test Sennheiser applications like Wireless System Manager and Control Cockpit, which provides professional software solutions for remotely monitoring and controlling Sennheiser’s wireless devices on a single screen.
